ChatCompletionMessage(content='Here’s the updated list of functions you can call:

| Function | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| **close_ticket** | Close a ticket by ID. |
| **create_ticket** | Create a new ticket with title, description, and priority. |
| **edit_ticket** | Modify an existing ticket’s title, description, status, or priority. |
| **get_ticket** | Retrieve a ticket by its ID. |
| **get_user_tickets** | Get all tickets created by the current user, optionally filtered by status. |
| **logout** | Log out the current user. |
| **resolve_ticket** | Resolve a ticket with a resolution text. |
| **ticket_get_login_status** | Check the login status of the current user. |
| **ticket_login** | Authenticate a user for the ticket system. |
| **cd** | Change the current working directory (one level at a time). |
| **cp** | Copy a file or directory within the current directory. |
| **diff** | Compare two files line‑by‑line. |
| **du** | Estimate disk usage of the current directory. |
| **echo** | Write or display content to/from a file. |
| **find** | Recursively search for files/directories by name. |
| **grep** | Search for lines containing a pattern in a file. |
| **ls** | List contents of the current directory (optionally show hidden files). |
| **mkdir** | Create a new directory in the current directory. |
